prefabs.name: 2 x ZSU 01
prefabs.author: Niels
prefabs.description: Two ZU-23 'Insurgent' AAA guns dug in with Ural-375 and ZIL-135 support trucks, ringed by M92 cargo, oil barrels, jerrycans and sandbag emplacements. Drops as a ready-made insurgent air-defense strongpoint.

prefabs.name: 2 x ZSU 02
prefabs.author: Niels
prefabs.description: Variant insurgent AAA position: two ZU-23 'Insurgent' guns with a Ural-375, fortified by a denser ring of M92 sandbags, cargo and oil barrels. A heavier-dug-in companion to '2 x ZSU 01'.
